trends.name: Iran Military Escalation & Energy Threats
trends.summary: Escalating military conflict: B-52s en route to Iran with bunker-busters, Israeli airstrikes on Tehran suburbs, Iran threatening to target US/Israel energy infrastructure and desalination plants. Trump demanding Strait of Hormuz opening in 48 hours or power plants will be 'obliterated.' This directly threatens 30%+ of global oil supply and shipping lanes.

trends.name: Oil Price Surge & Inflation Implications
trends.summary: Brent crude surging above $110/barrel amid Iran tensions, highest MOVE volatility in 12 months (109). Market debating whether oil overshoot translates to persistent inflation (2.25-2.5%) or if geopolitical premium unwinds. Oil embedded in thousands of consumer products, creating potential stagflation scenario vs. temporary supply shock.

trends.name: Crypto Liquidations & Risk-Off Sentiment
trends.summary: $240M+ in leveraged crypto positions liquidated in 60 minutes following Trump's Iran threats. Signals acute risk-off positioning unwind across risk assets. Demonstrates how geopolitical shocks trigger cascading liquidations in crypto markets before broader equity selloff.

trends.name: S&P 500 Weakness & 6-Month Lows
trends.summary: S&P 500 fallen to 6-month lows after 4th consecutive week of declines. Iran geopolitical crisis, weak job creation data (Powell: near-zero adjusted job growth), and credit spread warnings (CDX flashing signals) converging to break equity momentum. International stocks underperforming due to Middle East uncertainty.

trends.name: Fed Policy & Jobless Recovery Concerns
trends.summary: Fed Chair Powell signals alarm over 'very very low' job creation, noting adjusted 6-month trend shows effectively zero job growth after accounting for historical overcounting. Market interpreting this as potential policy pivot needed if labor market deteriorates further amid macro uncertainty.

trends.name: Maritime Security Threats & Shipping Routes
trends.summary: UKMTO (UK Maritime Trade Operations) issuing warnings for Persian Gulf shipping corridors. Iran threatening retaliatory strikes on energy infrastructure and desalination plants. Shipping insurance premiums spiking as Strait of Hormuz becomes active conflict zone. 30% of global seaborne oil transits this chokepoint.

trends.name: Tech Stock Volatility & AI Commodity Concerns
trends.summary: Microsoft share rout continues despite strong fundamentals; Unity facing headwinds from high stock-based compensation and looming AI threats. OpenClaw's ChatGPT moment sparks concerns that generative AI models are becoming commoditized, pressuring valuations of AI-dependent tech stocks amid broader market selloff.

trends.name: Trump Policy Volatility & Political Uncertainty
trends.summary: Trump messaging on Iran contradictory within 36 hours (no ceasefire → winding down → peace talks). ICE deployment threatened at airports Monday if DHS not funded. Policy whiplash creating trading uncertainty and hampering forward guidance for affected sectors (aviation, defense, immigration).

trends.name: Credit Spreads & Default Risk Warnings
trends.summary: CDX (Credit Default Swap Index) flashing warning signals of widening spreads, indicating market pricing in elevated default risk. Coinciding with equity weakness and geopolitical uncertainty, suggesting credit markets are front-running potential economic deterioration from sustained high energy prices or conflict escalation.

trends.name: Retail & Consumer Discretionary Sector Stress
trends.summary: Carvana facing gross profit per unit headwinds; Michelin downside not fully priced in; broader consumer exposure to energy price shocks. Walmart's digital price label rollout signals inflationary pricing power challenges. Sector under pressure from stagflationary environment and geopolitical demand uncertainty.

trends.name: Low Earth Orbit & Space Infrastructure Boom
trends.summary: Billions flowing into LEO satellite and space data center investments as secular growth trend. Positioning as alternative growth narrative amid macro uncertainty. Iranian threats to IT infrastructure underscore strategic importance of space-based communications and data resilience—potential upside catalyst for sector if conflict escalates.

trends.name: Interest Rates & Bond Market Volatility
trends.summary: MOVE volatility (rate option volatility) surged to 109 yesterday, highest since April 2025, signaling extreme uncertainty in bond markets. Market pricing multiple Fed scenarios: rates staying higher longer if oil inflation persists, or cuts if geopolitical shock triggers recession. Duration risk elevated across fixed income.
